dispatch_provenance.samples_delivery: Dispatch-time local prompt file read by separate gpt-6-luna medium reviewer; no source or prior reviews supplied
dispatch_provenance.tool_uses_by_reviewer: Reviewer reported prompt cat read, verdict write, length audit, sample-clarity update and audit, then short-reasoning revision and audit; report is reviewer-provided.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The patterns use short two- or three-item units and six positions, with familiar shapes or small numerals; identifying a repeated order is appropriate for the stated Grade 1 context.

competency_alignment.rationale: The topic and repeating units align with the competency, but every item asks the learner to select a pre-made sequence instead of creating a pattern using the specified materials.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Samples demonstrate recognition of correct sequences, not student creation of repeating patterns; no item asks learners to construct or extend a pattern themselves.

decomposition.reasoning: The three requirements partition the competency into the creation action, repeated-pattern property, and allowed kinds of elements; collectively they preserve the competency wording.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Both number and shape-name sequences appear with two- and three-item cycles, but the only task format is choosing among completed patterns and images or actual objects are absent.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Each item presents six terms built from only two or three familiar elements, with numerals no larger than 20; this keeps the pattern work manageable for Grade 1.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The packet changes the element set and cycle length and varies cloze versus multiple choice, yet all samples use the same recognition task and none asks for making a pattern.
